reference.title: Scenario 7 — Two-Level Nested Numbered List (sub steps) in Procedure
reference.shortdesc: Consider a numbered list with a second tier of numbered sub-items beneath selected parent items

section.p: Consider a numbered list with a second tier of numbered sub-items beneath selected parent items as part of the instructions or procedure.

entry.codeblock:
Configure the Server

  1. Configure the server.
    1. Open the configuration file.
    2. Set the port value.
  2. Restart the service.

<task id="configure_server"> <title>Configure the Server</title> <taskbody> <steps> <step> <cmd>Configure the server.</cmd> <substeps> <substep> <cmd>Open the configuration file.</cmd> </substep> <substep> <cmd>Set the port value.</cmd> </substep> </substeps> </step> <step> <cmd>Restart the service.</cmd> </step> </steps> </taskbody> </task>

section.p: Result: Two level numbered lists are preserved in <taskbody> as a <substeps> block inside <steps>.
